projects.title: Lumen — Adaptive Focus Timer
projects.summary: An iOS app that learns a user's attention rhythm and reshapes work sessions around it, instead of forcing a fixed Pomodoro block.
projects.description: Rigid timers ignore that focus capacity fluctuates across the day. Research with 12 students surfaced three failure modes; I shipped an on-device model that infers session length from interaction signals.
projects.impact: Shipped to TestFlight with 40 users; median focused minutes per session rose 23% over two weeks.
projects.learnings: Scoping an ML feature to ship on-device taught me to trade model accuracy against latency and privacy.

projects.title: OG Studio — Dynamic Image Engine
projects.summary: A self-hosted service that renders branded social preview images on the edge, in under 50 ms.
projects.description: Hand-made share images don't scale across hundreds of pages. I built a templating layer on Cloudflare Workers that composes typography and art into a cached PNG, keyed so identical inputs map to one durable asset.
projects.impact: Powers preview images across a live portfolio platform; eliminated manual asset work entirely. Used by 3 other developers.
projects.learnings: Designing for the edge forced discipline around cold starts and binary size — constraints I now treat as first-class design inputs.

projects.title: Transit — Wayfinding Redesign
projects.summary: A concept redesign of a city transit app focused on legibility for first-time riders.
projects.description: Dense route maps overwhelm new users. I ran a heuristic audit, rebuilt the information hierarchy, and prototyped a progressive-disclosure flow that reveals detail on demand. Reduce decisions per screen, not features.
projects.impact: Usability test (n=8) cut average route-finding time by 31% versus the original. Top-graded design in the cohort.
projects.learnings: How to defend subtractive design decisions with evidence rather than taste.
